ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

2. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

3. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 4
   C. 8
   D. 5

4. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 16
   C. 5
   D. 12

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 30
   C. 38
   D. 60

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

7. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 12
   C. 14
   D. 2

10. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

12. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

13. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

14. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 1

15. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

16. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

17. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

18. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

19. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

20. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 22
   C. 44
   D. 15

23. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

24. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
